dcterms:description: TREC CAR is a synthetic dataset based on Wikipedia that consists of about 29M passages. It includes queries generated by concatenating the title of a Wikipedia page with the heading of one of its sections, with passages marked as relevant to the corresponding query.
dcterms:title: TREC Complex Answer Retrieval (TREC-CAR)

dcterms:creator: Rodrigo Nogueira
Kyunghyun Cho
dcterms:description: MS MARCO is a dataset introduced by Microsoft for reading comprehension and adapted for retrieval. It contains 8.8M passages from web pages, gathered from Bing's results to 1M real-world queries, with sparse relevance judgments.
dcterms:title: MS MARCO Ranking
